- Read `AGENTS.md` first.
- Treat `.agent-code/` as the source of truth for prompts, contracts, templates, and standards.
- Generated files in `.cursor/`, `.codex/`, `.agents/`, and `AGENTS.md` are adapters.
- Do not hand-edit generated adapters unless you immediately rerender them.
- Skill nicknames and system agent names are intentionally different:
